source: Native Settings screenshots from installed Project Tab Icons 0.3.120, captured on 25 October 2026.
crop: Appearance: shared presets, section navigation, compact Preview and Style. Git: compact Preview and Tab layout. Groups: shared presets, navigation, table header and Add group, ending before saved group rows. IDE titles, navigation tree and all working project names and paths are outside the crops.
demoData: Frontend, Backend and Tools, branches and line counts are built-in fixtures. git_with_icon and group_git are generic appearance preset names.
processing: Rectangular crops of native screenshot captures, converted from their supplied JPEG bytes to PNG. No UI pixels, labels or pointer were redrawn, blurred or retouched; the pointer was moved outside the crop through native UI before capture.
settings: The saved group_git appearance was used without edits. Settings closed with Cancel. Four plugin XML files and laf.xml remain byte-identical.
